description: This file defines the PHP client class `CodeArtifactClient` for interacting with AWS CodeArtifact service. It includes method annotations for the various API operations available through the SDK, and extends the base `AwsClient` class.

classes.name: CodeArtifactClient
classes.description: The client class used to interact with the AWS CodeArtifact service, providing methods for various service operations.

methods.name: associateExternalConnection
methods.description: Associates an external connection with a CodeArtifact repository.

methods.name: associateExternalConnectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an external connection with a CodeArtifact repository.

methods.name: createDomain
methods.description: Creates a new domain in CodeArtifact.

methods.name: deleteDomainPermissionsPolicy
methods.description: Deletes permissions policy for a domain.

methods.name: deleteRepositoryPermissionsPolicy
methods.description: Deletes permissions policy for a repository.

methods.name: disassociateExternalConnection
methods.description: Disassociates an external connection from a repository.

methods.name: getAssociatedPackageGroup
methods.description: Gets details of an associated package group.

methods.name: getAssociatedPackageGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of an associated package group.

methods.name: getAuthorizationToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authorization token for accessing repositories.

methods.name: getDomainPermissionsPolicy
methods.description: Gets permissions policy for a domain.

methods.name: getPackageVersionAssetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets a package version asset.

methods.name: getPackageVersionReadme
methods.description: Gets the readme for a package version.

methods.name: getRepositoryPermissionsPolicy
methods.description: Gets permissions policy for a repository.

methods.name: listAllowedRepositoriesForGroup
methods.description: Lists allowed repositories for a group.

methods.name: listAllowedRepositoriesForGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists allowed repositories for a group.

methods.name: listPackageVersionAssets
methods.description: Lists assets for a package version.

methods.name: listPackageVersionDependencies
methods.description: Lists dependencies for a package version.

methods.name: listRepositoriesInDomainAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists repositories in a domain.

methods.name: putDomainPermissionsPolicy
methods.description: Sets permissions policy for a domain.

methods.name: putRepositoryPermissionsPolicy
methods.description: Sets permissions policy for a repository.

methods.name: updatePackageGroupOriginConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the origin configuration for a package group.

methods.name: updatePackageGroupOriginConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the origin configuration for a package group.

methods.name: updatePackageVersionsStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of package versions.
